title: recoverInterruptedReseed() never broadcast to peers, even after 3b's S9c fix to the primary reseed path

description: Flagged in 3b's own closing report as a discovered, out-of-scope residual: recoverInterruptedReseed()'s resume branch (Packages/LillistCore/Sources/LillistCore/Sync/DataStoreResetService.swift) never called propagator?.broadcast(...) -- a crash-recovered reseed never notified peers even after 3b's S9c fix made the PRIMARY (non-crashed) resetAndReseedFromThisDevice() path wait for its re-export to quiesce, then broadcast. Fixed during the 6a completeness sweep: recoverInterruptedReseed() now mirrors resetAndReseedFromThisDevice()'s exact quiesce-then-broadcast shape after its reimport/backupReconciler/widgetCacheReset steps (iCloudSync waits for quiesce, skipping the broadcast on timeout per S9c's own reasoning; localOnly broadcasts immediately). The outcome isn't surfaced anywhere new -- ReseedRecoveryOutcome's shape is unchanged, matching this method's existing best-effort launch-catch-up contract. Regression tests: recoverInterruptedReseedBroadcastsOnSuccess, recoverInterruptedReseedQuiesceTimeoutSkipsBroadcast (DataStoreResetServiceTests.swift).
